name: Scrapshielding grants a visible absorb shield on the Tinker's own critical hit, once per 10 sec (#10800)
contract: Scrapshielding 806627 reads "Your critical strikes now grant you a shield that absorbs ${$806628m1+$806628ppl1+$AP*.15+$SP*.6}
damage. Can occur only once every 10 seconds." The handler in AscensionTinkerEvents.cpp casts Scrapshield 806628 on the
Tinker when the Tinker itself lands a critical damaging or healing hit and the 10 sec internal cooldown is clear. A
level 60 Tinker with every critical rating pushed to the cap learns the talent and casts Scrap Shot 500549 at a dummy:
Scrapshield must appear on the Tinker as a visible positive aura carrying an absorb amount. A second critical Scrap
Shot three seconds later falls inside the internal cooldown and must not grant another.
